evidence.reason: Agent edit changes the discount base from amount to amount + 1, altering the computed total for all callers.
Human edit adds a currency parameter but leaves the return expression unchanged, so it is behavior-preserving and call-compatible.
Test asserts cart.total() === 18 and checkout(cart) === "USD 18.00"; the +1 in Cart.total would make these fail unless the fixture is adjusted.
Caller passes cart.total() to formatMoney; the changed total propagates to the checkout string.
Other callers of applyDiscount (PriceRule, SeasonalRule) still pass two arguments; the new third parameter is optional in practice but the signature change is not reflected in those call sites.

result.userExplanation: 合并后类型兼容，但 Cart.total 中多加的 1 会改变折后总价，导致现有结账测试失败，需要确认该 +1 是否为有意行为。
result.suggestedAction: 请修改 src/cart.ts 中 Cart.total 的调用，去掉 amount + 1 中的 +1（恢复为 applyDiscount(amount, 0.1, "USD")），或同步更新 test/shop.test.mjs 的期望值并说明加价原因。
